scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run check:sql && npm run check:lock && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.worker:deploy: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');const v=require('./package.json').version;const sha=(()=>{try{return execSync('git rev-parse --short HEAD').toString().trim()}catch{return 'unknown'}})();execSync(`wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.jsonc --var APP_VERSION:${v} --var GIT_SHA:${sha}`,{stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.worker:deploy:check: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');const v=require('./package.json').version;const sha=(()=>{try{return execSync('git rev-parse --short HEAD').toString().trim()}catch{return 'unknown'}})();execSync(`wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.jsonc --var APP_VERSION:${v} --var GIT_SHA:${sha}`,{stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.worker:deploy:staging: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');const v=require('./package.json').version;const sha=(()=>{try{return execSync('git rev-parse --short HEAD').toString().trim()}catch{return 'unknown'}})();execSync(`wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.jsonc --env staging --var APP_VERSION:${v} --var GIT_SHA:${sha}`,{stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply gainhub --local --config worker/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to worker/.wrangler/state
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute gainhub --local --file=worker/dev/seed.sql --config worker/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to worker/.wrangler/state
scripts.db:reset:local: node -e "import('node:fs').then(({rmSync})=>rmSync('worker/.wrangler/state/v3/d1',{recursive:true,force:true}))" && npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed:local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply gainhub --remote --config worker/wrangler.jsonc
